meta.title: YAML Formatter - S-Jiffy
meta.description: Format, validate, and convert YAML data. Clean syntax highlighting.
steps_yaml-formatter_1Desc: Paste YAML content into the input area. The formatter handles nested mappings, sequences, anchors, aliases, and multi-line strings.
steps_yaml-formatter_2Desc: Click Format to normalize indentation and spacing. Validation catches syntax errors like incorrect indentation, invalid characters, or duplicate keys.
steps_yaml-formatter_3Desc: Click Copy to grab the clean YAML output. Ideal for reviewing Kubernetes manifests, CI/CD configs, Docker Compose files, or any YAML-based configuration.
desc: Format, validate, and convert YAML data. Clean syntax highlighting.
